name: io.github.pain2hustle/zonemender
title: ZoneMender - Unofficial Cloudflare DNS MCP Server
description: Unofficial Cloudflare DNS MCP server and Wrangler-friendly zone fixer for AI agents. Scans and approval-gates DNS, SPF, DMARC, BIMI, MX, DKIM discovery, and Cloudflare Email Routing changes.

workers_subdomain.description: Your Cloudflare Workers subdomain after deploying worker/ with Wrangler.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for MCP_ACCESS_KEY configured as a Worker secret.

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Scoped Cloudflare API token with Zone Read, DNS Edit, and Email Routing Rules Edit permissions. Never use a Global API Key.
